title: AgentRail recette -- test agent scenario
description: The deterministic sequence of actions a test agent actually performs. The gap between this (real behavior) and the manifest capability_scope (declared) is what makes an agent correct or incorrect. credential_principal is the identity the agent authenticates as -- set it different from manifest.declared_identity.principal to build an identity_mismatch case.

agent_id.description: Must match the agent_id in the sibling manifest.json.

credential_principal.description: Identity the agent actually authenticates as. Equal to the declared principal for honest agents; different for identity_mismatch cases.

resource.description: Repo path the action targets, e.g. 'acme/widgets'.

approved.description: Whether an approval was obtained before this action (relevant for escalate actions, I6).
